summary.headline: Q1 FY27 pre-sales rose 567% YoY to INR409 crores and PAT grew 77% to INR46 crores at a 34.5% margin.
summary.overview: Sri Lotus reported strong Q1 FY27 growth: pre-sales INR409 crores, collections INR150 crores (+115% YoY), revenue INR132 crores (+116%), and EBITDA INR48 crores (36.4% margin). Management reiterated FY27 guidance of INR1,800-2,000 crores pre-sales and 55-60% revenue and PAT growth. A new Juhu commercial redevelopment (GDV about INR1,600 crores) was won, and the company reported a net cash balance sheet of INR623 crores. Q&A surfaced some inconsistencies on launch timing and the split of Q1 pre-sales between new and existing launches.

segments.name: Residential redevelopment (Mumbai ultra-luxury)
segments.commentary: Core focus; 17 of 22 pipeline projects are redevelopment-led. Management says micro-market pricing is 10-15% above other developers, with 5-10% price rises seen over the past year.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.commentary: Two commercial projects in the pipeline; Juhu commercial-cum-retail redevelopment (GDV about INR1,600 crores) won, expected to start next year after approvals and take 3-4 years to complete.

guidance_outlook: FY27 pre-sales guidance maintained at INR1,800-2,000 crores; management said it will 'easily achieve' INR1,800 crores.
FY27 revenue and PAT growth guidance of 55-60% maintained.
EBITDA margin guidance 35-40% and PAT margin 25-30% stated in the prepared remarks; in Q&A the CEO quoted EBITDA margin of 33-36%, a discrepancy.
FY27 cash collections target of about INR1,000 crores, supported by billing on Arcadian and Varun (each about 90% complete) and Amalfi (60-70%) by year-end.

Four further launches in FY27 with combined GDV of INR3,500-4,000 crores: Lotus Sky Plaza (Oshiwara, about INR1,500 crores, H1-end or early Q3), Lotus Odyssey (Bandstand, about INR1,000 crores, Q4), Lotus Portofino (Versova, about INR500 crores, within 3-4 months), Lotus Aurelia (Napean Sea Road, INR600-700 crores).
Gift City project: mixed-use approvals (commercial, retail, residential) expected by end-2026, with construction to start after approvals.
Promoter stake about 82%; management targets dilution to 75% or below within the remaining two years of a three-year window, with no investor discussions yet.
capex_capacity: Two projects launched in Q1 FY27: Lotus Trident (Andheri West) and Lotus Aquaria (Prabhadevi), together GDV of INR1,350 crores; Aquaria company GDV about INR800 crores (saleable, excluding tenant areas), starting price about INR85,000 per sq ft.
Varun: plinth just completed, about 20 slabs; RCC work targeted by January and 90% of work by March.
Arcadian and Varun targeted at 90% of project cost and Amalfi at 60-70% by end-FY27.

Juhu commercial redevelopment: plot over 5,000 sq m; start next year after plan approvals, 3-4 years to complete. Part of the area to be rehoused for existing tenants, remainder for commercial pipeline; no rental retention decided.
Of the INR550 crores earmarked for subsidiary projects (Amalfi, Arcadian, Varun), INR271 crores deployed as of 30 June 2026. Net IPO proceeds about INR732 crores after INR792 crores fresh issue.
demand_pricing: Q1 pre-sales of INR409 crores: management said only about INR25 crores came from the two new launches; the remainder came from projects launched in FY26 and earlier. Trident already reported about INR150 crores of sales within one month, in July-August.
Management said about INR400-plus crores of sales came from Trident, Aquaria and Celestia over the last two quarters.
Sales pace: 20-30% of inventory sold at launch, then about 30% of stock offloaded per year over a roughly three-year build cycle.
Brand campaign across 11 Mumbai coastal projects is ongoing; sales and marketing spend about 1% of pre-sales, which management expects to be offset by lower brokerage.
Management cited Mumbai luxury housing demand growth of more than 11% while the broader market moderated; constrained supply in Worli, Bandra and South Mumbai.
Versova: three existing sea-facing projects with more society talks under way.

qa_highlights.question: Can the INR409 crore pre-sales support the INR2,000 crore FY27 guidance, and what supports 55-60% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO Sanjay Jain said the company is confident of easily achieving the INR1,800 crore pre-sales guidance, citing four new launches and strong response to Trident, Aquaria and Celestia.

qa_highlights.question: Timing and GDV of the upcoming launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Lotus Sky Plaza (Oshiwara, about INR1,500 crores) at H1-end or start of Q3; Lotus Odyssey (Bandstand, about INR1,000 crores) in Q4; Lotus Portofino (Versova, about INR500 crores) within 3-4 months; Lotus Aurelia (Napean Sea Road, INR600-700 crores).

qa_highlights.question: Juhu project details, margin and rental plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is more than 5,000 sq m plot in middle Juhu with existing shops and offices to be rehoused; no rental retention for this project. EBITDA around 40% and PAT 25-30% expected, which management said it will achieve or beat.

qa_highlights.question: Gap between Q1 pre-sales split and launch-driven sales?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO Rakesh Gupta said about INR25 crores came from the two new launches, with the balance from FY26 and earlier launches. The CEO had earlier cited Trident's INR150 crores within one month, which relates to July-August rather than Q1.

qa_highlights.question: Cash collection goal and EBITDA margin trajectory?
qa_highlights.answer: Collection target about INR1,000 crores this year as billing rises on Arcadian, Varun and Amalfi. CEO said EBITDA margin is in the 33-36% range, which differs from the 35-40% guidance in the prepared remarks.

qa_highlights.question: Price increases and premium versus peers?
qa_highlights.answer: Price rises of 5-10% over the past year. Pricing about 10-15% above other developers in the same micro-markets, per the CEO.

qa_highlights.question: Leverage plans and net worth?
qa_highlights.answer: Investment is about 10% of GDV in redevelopment. Management cited total GDV of about INR18,000 crores and net worth of about INR1,900 crores, with annual net worth additions expected.

qa_highlights.question: Promoter stake dilution timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Promoter stake about 82%; management said there are three years to reach 75% or below, with two years remaining, but no investor discussions yet.
